mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_HOTBILL_STATUS ( CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, USECASE, STATUS, REQUEST_DATETIME, UPDATE_DATETIME, ERROR_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{contractNumber}, #{hotbillDate}, #{usecase, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{requestDatetime}, #{updateDatetime}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, USECASE, STATUS, REQUEST_DATETIME, UPDATE_DATETIME, ERROR_MESSAGE FROM TB_HOTBILL_STATUS WHERE CONTRACT_NUMBER = #{contractNumber} AND HOTBILL_DATE = #{hotbillDate}
